# Navigation Menu

Combine native links and expandable navigation panels in one bar.

## Examples

### Product

Combine native product links with disclosure triggers in one navigation surface.

<ComponentExample component="navigation-menu" scenario="product" title="Product" description="Combine native product links with disclosure triggers in one navigation surface." :index="0" />

### Links

Preserve native link navigation alongside compound menu triggers.

## Keyboard interaction

| Key | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Arrow Left</kbd> / <kbd>Arrow Right</kbd> | Move between root menu items. |
| <kbd>Arrow Down</kbd> / <kbd>Arrow Up</kbd> | Open a branch or move inside its vertical item list. |
| <kbd>Home</kbd> / <kbd>End</kbd> | Move to the first or last item at the current level. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Open a branch or invoke the current item. |
| <kbd>Escape</kbd> | Close the branch and return to its owner. |

## Accessibility

Native links keep link semantics while disclosure triggers expose expanded state for compound panels.

See the [corresponding WAI-ARIA pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/disclosure/examples/disclosure-navigation/) for the host accessibility contract.
